page.layout: One page of text: a title at the top in two lines, then a two-column index of Hebrew words with figures. Each side has its Hebrew words with a middle column of figures on the left block, plus letter headings for the alphabet groups.

main_text.head: Index aliquarum vocum Hebraicarum quæ in Commentario explicatæ sunt.

page.notes: Column headings are Hebrew letters (א, ט, ג, ה, ח, י on the left; כ, ל, מ, נ, ע, פ, צ, ק, ש on the right) and are set in the margin beside their groups; the arrangement of the letter headings relative to rows is approximate. Several Hebrew words contain boxed or bracketed letters in the print (e.g. אול, כרם, לביא, מנחה, מכלה, פליט, צרקה, קצפה), which are rendered approximately. Some right-column figures (e.g. 25.26, 24.25) and the alignment of rows are uncertain. The "צרקה" and "קצפה" readings are doubtful. The ornament above the title is not transcribed.
